title: Professional 1, Engineering Intern
description:
KAYGEN is an emerging leader in providing top talent for technology-based staffing services. We specialize in providing high-volume contingent staffing, direct hire staffing and project-based solutions to companies worldwide ranging from startups to Fortune 500 and Managed Service Providers (MSP) across a wide variety of industries. 

Internship Role:
1st Shift M-F (start time flexible 7AM or 8AM) 8 hr shift

We are seeking a hardworking and determined Engineering student to join our team as a summer intern. Students are typically assigned a mentor who will direct their summer or co-op work experience. Work on project assignments will be commensurate with the student's academic background to take advantage of their technical expertise and provide real life application of their classroom knowledge. At the same time, opportunities will be provided for students to expand their knowledge outside the boundaries of their classroom experiences.

Typical roles our engineer interns hold are:

• Process Engineer Roles

• Operations / Production Engineer Roles

• Project Management Roles

Ensures compliance with quality systems, policies, procedures and best practices, and all local, state, federal and safety regulations, policies and procedures. Regular, punctual attendance is an essential job function. Ability to read and write and converse in English. Willing and able to uphold Values.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

1. Provide support in a fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment

2. Troubleshooting/Root Cause analysis

3. Work with a mentor on project assignments which are commensurate with academic background

4. Work with a mentor on project assignments outside of classroom curriculum to gain experience

5. Apply classroom knowledge to real life applications while using technical expertise

6. Other duties as required to support the needs of the business.





DELIVERABLES

· Successful completion of work/project assignments

· Gain application experience of curriculum







SUPERVISION


  • This role does not have direct reports.









QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

1. Minimum Education:

This position has the following educational requirements:


  • H.S, Diploma/GED
    BA/BS Degree- Preferred Completed Sophomore year in an engineering program



2. Minimum Experience/Qualifications:

· 18 years of age or older

· Legally authorized to work in the United States

· Possesses or currently pursuing a degree in Engineering

· Available to work a minimum of eight continuous weeks

· Must be willing to work in any of our Columbus manufacturing locations


  1. 3 Minimum Knowledge, Skills, or Abilities (KSA’s):

    SolidWorks/AutoCAD (preferred)
    Fabrication, automation, industrial experience (preferred)

    4. Physical Capacity Profile: N/A

Description:
Title: Technician
Location: TMMK, Georgetown, KY
Travel: 25% both Domestic and international
Overtime: 25%

This resource will be responsible for checking the quality of new models, check the body weld tooling as well as it’s accessories.
They will also be responsible for doing the first builds of the model.
Hiring Manager needs someone with strong knowledge of body structure and experience working with portable CMM equipment (Vectorarm, Perceptron, & FARO).
· Metrology experience.
· Having experience with 3d modelling software is a plus.

Interview process –
Video call with STAR format interview of 60 minutes with Managers

Job Description -
Checking body welding tooling and part accuracy using Vectorarm, Perceptron, & FARO portable CMM equipment.
Gather part information from Digital Engineering systems, i.e., PolyWorks, Catia and 3D imaging software.
Checking part quality using hand tools and quality checking fixtures.
Support Sheetmetal Sub-assy. and Body build trials and activities during pre-production events.
Troubleshoot equipment, tooling, parts, and part fitting.
Analyze part and sub-assembly data and provide feedback to project leader(s).

Requirements:
2-5 Years Automotive/ Aerospace Quality Metrology experience (Sheet-metal QA)
Capable of using portable CMM equipment, Scanners, Laser Trackers. (FARO, Vectorarm, Leica, Creaform).
Experience with 3D comparison softwares like PolyWorks, Cam 2, Scene, PC DMIS.
Strong mechanical ability. Small hand tools for adjusting / modifying part datums.
Strong Computer skills, including: MS PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
Able to create and maintain schedules.
Ability to work weekends, holidays, off shifts, and overtime.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Ability to handle medium to heavy physical work.
Ability to be flexible and adjust to changes that may occur daily.
Be a self-starter and self-motivated to continuously improve skills and new tech.

description:

Job Title: Senior SMR – IGA Migration (SailPoint to Saviynt)
Location: Flexible
Duration: 7 Months

Contract description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and define the future-state IGA architecture on Saviynt, including identity model, integrations, and lifecycle design.

  • Develop and execute the IGA migration strategy and phased transition plan from SailPoint to Saviynt.

  • Define and document future-state integrations across HR, ITSM, directories, and enterprise applications.

  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams to manage execution, dependencies, and risks.

  • Provide clear weekly and monthly project status reporting, including progress, risks, and decision points.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in IAM / IGA architecture or engineering roles within enterprise environments.

  • Proven experience leading Saviynt implementations or large-scale IGA migrations.

  • Hands-on experience with SailPoint in production environments.

  • Strong expertise in identity lifecycle management, integrations, and access governance.

  • Ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly to senior technical and business stakeholders.

The candidate must be available to attend the office during the first full week as part of the onboarding process, as well as for occasional in‐person meetings if required. The role also requires availability to work in the EST time zone.

Pay Range: $60-70

title: Oracle Fusion techno functional Consultant
description:
KAYGEN is an emerging leader in providing top talent for technology-based staffing services. We specialize in providing high-volume contingent staffing, direct hire staffing and project-based solutions to companies worldwide ranging from startups to Fortune 500 and Managed Service Providers (MSP) across a wide variety of industries. 
We are looking for Oracle cloud developer / Oracle Fusion techno-functional . Please share your resume with rate and availability.

Location : Los Angeles, CA 
Onsite : Hybrid ( 3 days every weeks )
Duration  :6-12months 

NOTE : MUST BE LOCAL TO Los Angeles, CA
  • End-to-end migration execution : Perform data extraction, cleansing, transformation, and loading (ETL) for Oracle Fusion modules such as Finance, Projects, Inventory, Order Management, Procurement, and HCM
  • Data mapping & reconciliation : Prepare and maintain data mapping documents, reconcile source and target data, and resolve discrepancies
  • Validation & testing : Validate migrated data for accuracy and completeness; support mock runs, testing, cutover, and go-live activities
  • Scripting & automation : Develop and execute SQL/PL/SQL scripts for migration tasks; use ETL tools like FBDI, HDL, ADFDI, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • Coordination : Work closely with functional, technical, and business teams to gather requirements, validate templates, and resolve data quality issues
  • Documentation : Help develop migration documentation, status reports, and reconciliation reports
  • Integration & system design : Design and implement system integrations using OIC or other middleware; ensure data integrity across systems

 

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience : 4+ years in Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud data migration; proven experience in at least one full-cycle Fusion implementation
  • Technical skills : Strong knowledge of SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle tables/data structures, ETL tools, and data migration methodologies
  • Tools : Proficiency with FBDI, HDL, ADFDI, ETL tools, OIC, and integration platforms
  • Analytical & problem-solving : Ability to identify and resolve data quality issues; strong troubleshooting skills
  • Communication : Excellent coordination and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams

 

Preferred Skills

  • Certifications in Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud and SAP
  • Experience with additional SAP and Oracle modules (Finance, SCM, Procurement, HCM)
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and reconciliation best practices
